verdict.rationale: Supabase exposes documented, auto-generated REST and GraphQL APIs, a public OpenAPI spec (confirmed by probe), type generation, and CLI/SDK tooling that AI-native users/agents can drive programmatically, plus an official MCP server for AI assistant integration. missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of API completeness/versioning guarantees and clearer production-safety guidance for AI-driven API use (community notes flagged risks with MCP/service_role misuse).
